Additionally, banks are urging central bank intervention to manage the growing dollar surplus.

Foreign fund inflows supported the rupee but it faced pressure from rising crude prices. The US proposed 25 percent tariffs on imports from India, which raised inflation concerns. India rejected these allegations and expressed commitment to finalize a bilateral trade deal.

stories.headline: Microsoft details how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate cyberattacks
stories.what_happened: Microsoft has published the technical architecture of ARTEX, an AI framework in wide use since July 2026 that runs cyberattacks with specialized agents and almost no human involvement. State-backed groups from China and North Korea, along with criminal organizations, are already using the system. Microsoft recommends deception techniques like honeypots and faked success signals as defenses, but how long those will hold up against agents that learn and adapt remains an open question. stories.headline: The same gene that helps define neuron identity may also balance developing brain circuits
stories.what_happened: A gene that helps set a neuron's identity also affects how many inputs it receives from other neurons. New research led by neuroscientists at King's College London finds that the molecules neurons use to wire together in the developing mouse brain depend on the role these neurons will play in the adult. The connections these neurons form also depend on how electrically active they are during development.
